name: DEEPA JEWELLERS LIMITED
about: Deepa Jewellers Limited engages in designing, processing, and suppling of hallmarked gold and precious stone studded jewellery in India. The company offers vaddanam (waist belt), CNC machine cut bangles, gents kada, vanky(armlet), dandpatti (bajuband), gundlamala haaram (traditional neck piece), gundlamala necklace, kangan, earring, mangtika (forehead pendant), maatil (ear chain), champasaralu (ear to hair chain), jada (braid ornament), and rings. It also provides job work services by processing customer supplied materials into finished ornaments and trade in silver ornaments, 18 and 20 karat jewellry, and gold bullion. The company distributes its products to jewelry retail chains and standalone stores. Deepa Jewellers Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
